highlights_headline: Upcoming native fixes correct mask-filtered glyphs when reloading changes their outline, format or bounds.

bullets.lead: Glyph reloads no longer reuse stale outline state
bullets.detail: Mask filtering rasterizes the reloaded glyph's own path, clears incompatible or non-overlapping masks, and preserves full plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, format assertions and uncleared mask planes without changing managed APIs.
